Slipway's speed is enforced, not claimed. Four gates in `npm run check` build the fixture sites and fail a pull request that misses a budget. This page reads the same constants and measurement functions, so the figures cannot drift from what CI runs.

## JavaScript

**Budget: 30 KiB (30,720 bytes) of Brotli-compressed JavaScript per page.** The gate counts each page's external and inline scripts and the static modules they import, each compressed once at Brotli's maximum quality.

| Fixture | Pages | Largest page | Compressed bytes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `docs-site` | 594 | `404.html` | 150 |
| `rtl-site` | 6 | `commands/index.html` | 150 |

[The JavaScript gate](https://github.com/arminazimi/slipway/blob/main/tools/js-budget-engine/run.ts) fails a page over the budget.

## CSS

**Budget: 40 KiB (40,960 bytes) of Brotli-compressed CSS for the whole site.** Every stylesheet a build writes counts, whether a page links it yet or not.

| Fixture | Stylesheets | Compressed bytes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `docs-site` | 4 | 9,625 |
| `rtl-site` | 3 | 9,562 |

[The CSS gate](https://github.com/arminazimi/slipway/blob/main/tools/css-budget-engine/run.ts) fails a build over the budget.

## Lighthouse

**Budget: 95 or higher in each of 4 categories** — performance, accessibility, best practices, and SEO — on mobile settings, for 4 pages that stand in for the fixture's page shapes: `/install/`, `/security/`, `/dashboard/`, and `/rules/artifacts-001/`. Scores depend on the runner and the network simulation, so [the Lighthouse gate](https://github.com/arminazimi/slipway/blob/main/tools/lighthouse/run.ts) measures them on every CI run; this page links the gate instead of freezing a machine-specific score.

## Build time

**Budget: 10 s (10,000 ms) for one cold build of the 594-page `docs-site` fixture.** A cold build discards the cache, so it measures what a contributor waits for rather than a warm reuse. Build time depends on the runner, so [the build-time gate](https://github.com/arminazimi/slipway/blob/main/tools/build-time/run.ts) measures it on CI; this page links the gate instead of freezing a machine-specific time.

## How the page stays honest

`site/performance.md` is generated by `tools/perf-report/run.ts`. `npm run check` reruns the generator and fails when the page and the gates disagree; `node tools/perf-report/run.ts --write` updates it. The JavaScript and CSS figures are deterministic for a checkout because they are read from fixture builds of the same source, with Brotli at its maximum quality. The Lighthouse scores and the cold-build time are measured on the CI runner and linked above instead of being copied here.
